November 1,2026 marks 42 years since 1984 anti-Sikh riots broke out in Delhi. Complacent & complicit Govt, Delhi Police & Congress party let India and especially the capital’s Sikhs down with three days of targeted killings, loot & rape in the national capital.
In this edition of , Shekhar Gupta narrates his reporter’s account of the 1984 Delhi massacre following Indira Gandhi’s assassination.
Originally published on 31 March 2023.
